summary: Fresno County lookout: built by the CCC in 1934 for Sierra NF, run by the state from 1952, with its original BC-301 cab; current access not found.

facts.design: BC-301 cab on a 20-foot steel tower
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Fresno Kings Unit (Cal Fire FKU)

events.note: Newspaper reports a federal fire lookout station planned at Camp Clan on top of Black Mountain, with a road to be built
Built by the CCC for the Sierra National Forest; a May 1935 newspaper item says the stations were completed the summer before
California Department of Forestry assumed sole operation of the lookout; a November 1952 newspaper item says the state was going to operate a lookout there

notes_for_editor: No current status, staffing or access found. Two searches returned only other Black Mountain lookouts (Plumas NF near Milford, Wyoming, Idaho) and a 2013 CAL FIRE incident on Black Mountain Road near Auberry; none of those is this tower and none is used. Record ownership 'federal' is not checked: the Register names CDF as administrator and Sierra NF as cooperator, so the editor may want to review it. The undated 'two story' note on Forest Lookouts conflicts with the Register on when the room beneath the cab was added. Height 6.1 m comes from the 20-foot tower on Forest Lookouts; the Register gives no height. The description's '(MVT 10/91)' credit suggests the 'recently replaced' stairway may date from the early 1990s.
